description: List graph edges for an event, trip, place, or person. Each link has a confirmation: explicit | pending | confirmed | rejected. A rejected link is listed only as a record of the decision: it is not a relationship, and every other read leaves it out. ($0.05; API key required)
name: get_entity_links

items.description: A stored life_entity_links row plus its derived confirmation (explicit | pending | confirmed | rejected). A rejected link is kept only as a record of the decision and is not a relationship.
